description:
GET /queries/id/results: `results`, the query's best items under any of `prefixes` (e.g. ["tools/"]; all
items by default), best first, each with its `score`, DNA's estimate of the grade you would give it (on the
grades' scale once the grid has some; before, only the order means anything), as list_items shows
it, without content. `ungraded`: leave out the items you already graded for this query. Grade what you judged with
put_grade: the results learn from it within a few seconds.
name: get_results
